content.text: I need to calculate the wheel positions first. The wheels should be at the bottom corners, half embedded into the body. Let me calculate the positions for all four wheels.

input.PythonCode:
# Car dimensions
car_length = 200
car_width = 100
car_height = 100

# Wheel dimensions
wheel_radius = 25
wheel_thickness = 10

# Wheels should be at bottom corners, half embedded
# This means the wheel centers are at z = 0 (bottom of car)
# For half embedded, the wheel center should be at the edge of the car body

# Calculate wheel positions
# Front left wheel
fl_x = wheel_thickness / 2  # Half thickness from front edge
fl_y = 0  # At left edge
fl_z = wheel_radius  # Center at wheel radius height

# Front right wheel
fr_x = wheel_thickness / 2  # Half thickness from front edge
fr_y = car_width  # At right edge
fr_z = wheel_radius  # Center at wheel radius height

# Rear left wheel
rl_x = car_length - wheel_thickness / 2  # Half thickness from rear edge
rl_y = 0  # At left edge
rl_z = wheel_radius  # Center at wheel radius height

# Rear right wheel
rr_x = car_length - wheel_thickness / 2  # Half thickness from rear edge
rr_y = car_width  # At right edge
rr_z = wheel_radius  # Center at wheel radius height

print(f"Front left wheel: center at ({fl_x}, {fl_y}, {fl_z})")
print(f"Front right wheel: center at ({fr_x}, {fr_y}, {fr_z})")
print(f"Rear left wheel: center at ({rl_x}, {rl_y}, {rl_z})")
print(f"Rear right wheel: center at ({rr_x}, {rr_y}, {rr_z})")

# Wheel axis is along Y direction (width of car)
# Height vector for cylinder pointing in Y direction with length = thickness
print(f"\nWheel height vector: (0, {wheel_thickness}, 0)")
